notes.title: v1.0.1 update log
notes.notes:
v1.0.1 Update
We added a miss counter to the main game. You can now see how many times you miss the pin during play.
There's also a new Steam achievement: finish all 21 levels with fewer than 10 misses.

Update Details:


 Added miss tracking and best score recording.
 Implemented game save/load system.
 Updated the menu UI.
